title: Surface Elevation, Shadows & Depth Systems in Dark Themes
subtopicTitle: Surface Elevation, Shadows & Depth Systems in Dark Themes
problemStatement:
Why drop shadows fail in dark mode and how to construct depth through surface lightness tiering.

**Enterprise Importance**:
In light mode, drop shadows simulate elevation. In dark mode, shadows are invisible against dark backgrounds, requiring a totally different elevation strategy.
interviewTrap: Applying the exact same black box-shadows in dark mode as light mode.

detailedExplanation.conceptualOverview: In dark mode, elevated surfaces become progressively lighter rather than casting darker shadows. Higher elevation = closer to ambient light source = higher lightness.
